content:
**The warren gets rebuilt on Monday.**
Season 3 starts at 06:00 Monday with a new roster. New rules, a new rat, and two runts thrown in the gutter. A taste:
- Pups come out at their mother's ★. A ★3 Brood-Mother births ★3 pups.
- **Rot-Chemist** is new. When it dies it bursts and hits every foe.
- Dawn-Runt and Dusk-Runt are gone.
Full notes Monday morning. Every board starts from nothing, so nobody gets a head start.
https://jelledenmark.github.io/we-ride-at-dawn-2/
